description: This file implements a class `PdfEncryptionV5` that handles encryption and decryption for PDF documents using encryption version 5 (PDF 2.0). It includes methods to initialize encryption, validate passwords, and handle cryptographic operations like AES encryption/decryption, as well as managing encryption parameters and keys according to the security handler specifications.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionV5
classes.description: A class implementing PDF Standard Security Handler’s encryption version 5 (PDF 2.0), providing methods to initialize encryption, validate passwords, and perform cryptographic operations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the encryption parameters with optional metadata encryption.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Initializes encryption parameters from the loaded security handler state.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates an input password against the stored encryption data, determining if it is a user or owner password.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Configures encryption dictionary and keys to prepare the document for saving with encryption.
